content: Cross-checking Backloggd, GameVentory, PLAYBACK, and Game Collector shows common user-facing expectations: catalogue search and detail, library states, ratings or reviews, custom lists, public sharing, filters, and ownership records. Advanced collector products model copies separately from games and capture medium, platform or region, edition, condition or completeness, purchase details, notes, and sometimes photos or location. Import and export are high-value onboarding and portability capabilities.
